title: bots: ruins race and monument building
criteria:
Bot behaviour for the endgame (T26b). English only, no Thai text. Bots use services only. EDITING RULE: realm/bot/modules.py and brain.py already exist: use small targeted Edit operations only (append functions / extend registries). Existing: ruin tiles (Tile.kind == 'ruin', Tile.animals = remaining guardians, Tile.oasis_owner_village_id = owning village), cfg.ruins (guardians with def_inf/def_cav/count, monument_win_level 50), building 'monument' (needs palace level 10 AND the village owning a ruin: services villages.owns_ruin), Action kinds 'attack' and 'build' already exist.
1) `modules.monument(ctx) -> list[Action]`: when villages.owns_ruin(ctx.s, ctx.village.id) is True and ctx.levels.get('palace', 0) >= 10 (requirements empty via construction.missing_requirements) and the monument level (ctx.levels.get('monument', 0)) is below cfg.ruins.monument_win_level: return ONE Action kind 'build', score 5.5, params {'slot': existing monument slot or the first empty center slot (use the helpers already in modules.py), 'btype': 'monument'}, module 'monument'. Otherwise [].
2) `modules.ruins_race(ctx) -> list[Action]`: only when a ruin exists in the world (Tile kind 'ruin') and the village has a rally_point level >= 1 and troops at home: candidates = ruin tiles NOT owned by this player's villages (owner village None or another player's); for each, defence = for an unowned ruin 10 + sum(guardian_count * max(def_inf, def_cav)) from the tile.animals dict and cfg.ruins.guardians (own estimate from public tile data), for an owned ruin 10; the army = all home units whose type is not 'scout' and not 'settler' and not 'chief' (cfg.units types) with attack = sum(attack * count); a candidate qualifies when attack >= 1.3 * defence; choose the candidate with the smallest torus distance (movement.distance) then (x, y); return ONE Action kind 'attack', score 3.8, params {'to_x', 'to_y', 'units': army}, module 'ruins_race'; [] otherwise (also [] when memory shows two recent failures against that tile: memory['targets'][f'ruin:{x},{y}']['fail_times'] using the existing recent_fails style logic is NOT required; skip memory).
3) Registry in brain.py: add both modules to `_MODULES`; weight keys: 'monument' -> 'monument' (default weight 1.0 for every personality when the key is missing) and 'ruins_race' -> 'ruins_race' with default 0.0 when missing, so only personalities that list `ruins_race` in their weights take part (bots.yaml warlord gets `ruins_race: 1.5`: add it to the warlord weights line in realm/config/bots.yaml and to BUILD.md section 5.5 with the same text; make sure `_DEFAULT_WEIGHT` or the existing default-handling code supports these two defaults; the military/raid damping before active_from_day also applies to 'ruins_race'). The build-queue-full skip in collect_candidates must also skip the module 'monument' (it only produces builds).
== Tests == tests/bot/test_ruins_bot.py (DB fixtures `s`, `cfg`, `t0`; world = worlds.create_world(s, seed=1, speed=1, player_name='ผู้เล่น', tribe='stonehold', bot_count=2, cfg=cfg, real_now=t0); bot 1 = warlord (personality via its profile), its village A moved to (30, 30), rally_point level 1 (slot 39), Real columns only). Hand-computed: a ruin tile forced at (35, 30) (kind 'ruin', animals {'stone_guard': 40}); defence = 10 + 40*150 = 6010; 200 swordsmen at home (attack 8000 >= 1.3*6010 = 7813) -> one 'attack' action score 3.8 to (35, 30) with units {'swordsman': 200}; 150 swordsmen (6000 < 7813) -> []; scouts/settlers/chiefs at home are not sent; two ruins, (35, 30) distance 5 and (30, 40) distance 10 -> the nearer qualifying one; an owned ruin (owner = another village, animals {}) needs only attack >= 13 -> 10 swordsmen qualify (400 >= 13); a ruin owned by this player's own village is skipped; no ruin in the world -> []; a 'farmer' personality (no ruins_race weight) never produces a ruins_race action through brain.collect_candidates; the warlord produces it with the weight 1.5 (score 3.8*1.5 = 5.7 once active_from_day (10) has passed: use now = t0 + 11 days; before day 10 the military damping 0.3 applies: 3.8*1.5*0.3 = 1.71 at now t0). monument module: village owns a ruin (tile owner = A) and palace level 10 (Building at a center slot) -> one 'build' action score 5.5 with btype 'monument' on the first empty center slot; existing monument at slot 24 level 3 -> that slot; no ruin owned -> []; palace 9 -> []; monument level 50 -> []; brain integration: a 'hard' bot village that owns a ruin with palace 10, enough stock (set 50000 each) executes the monument build (a BuildQueue row of type 'monument' exists) and a hard warlord with a qualifying army and a reachable ruin creates a Movement mission 'attack' to the ruin tile (stock untouched).
notes:
- Real columns only in tests: Tile.kind/animals/oasis_owner_village_id, Building, Troop, Village, Player.
- Use ONE query for ruin tiles; modules are read-only.
- Never commit; never call datetime.now(); run only the test_cmd.
- Existing tests must keep passing.
